name: 45 degree hyperextension (arms in front of chest) (side pov)
description: A back extension on a 45 degree bench viewed from the side, targeting the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Set the pad at hip height and hook your heels under the roller.
Cross your arms over your chest and keep your body straight.
Lower your torso with a flat back until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Raise back up until your body is in line, without overarching.
Move slowly and squeeze your glutes at the top.
